'''Adine Lewin''' is a [[Two Rivers]] resident.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Adine Lewin}} She is married to [[Flann Lewin]].

== Appearance ==
She is plump.

== Activities ==
She challenges Perrin about the Whitecloak accusation that he is a darkfriend.{{ref/book|4|32}}

She helps defend [[Emond's Field]] against the invading [[Trolloc]] army.{{ref/book|4|56}}
